edition.publication: Bonn: Emil Strauss (ed. I. von Doellinger and F. H. Reusch), 1887
edition.title: Die Selbstbiographie des Cardinals Bellarmin, lateinisch und deutsch, mit geschichtlichen Erlaeuterungen (Bonn, 1887)

work.author: Robert Bellarmine
work.description: Bellarmine's third-person memoir, written in June 1613 at the request of fellow Jesuits; retrospective and edifying in genre, first published among the acta of the beatification process (1675 per the 1907 Catholic Encyclopedia). Its transmission includes a 1762 printing with variant readings recorded by the 1887 Bonn edition.
work.title: Vita Roberti Cardinalis Bellarmini quam ipsemet scripsit
